    Live data sync: Dashboard pulls from your published Google Sheet (column AH · Po Value) on every page load. Currency: All values displayed in BDT. Non-BDT amounts convert via CONFIG.FX_RATES (USD: 110, EUR: 120, INR: 1.30). Fallback: If live fetch fails, an embedded snapshot loads automatically.
    Configuration

    Live data source

    For live updates to work, your Google Sheet must be either shared as "Anyone with the link → Viewer" or published to the web. The "Publish to web" option (File → Share → Publish to web) is the most reliable.

    The ID is the part of your Sheet URL between /d/ and /edit. Sheet must be set to "Anyone with link can view".
    Usually 0 for the first sheet tab. Check the URL after #gid=.
    Paste the URL from File → Share → Publish to web → CSV. Most reliable option.
